conveyorArchitectures.name: High-Capacity Multi-Tank Flight-Type Conveyor (Hobart / Meiko / Hobart FT1000, 14,000 Dishes/Hr, 7.5 kW Wash Pump, Dual 500 CFM Stacks)
conveyorArchitectures.curtainMaterial: Weighted Triple-Layer Chemical-Resistant Hypalon / Viton Fabric
conveyorArchitectures.impellerMetallurgy: Cast CF8M (316 Grade) Stainless Steel with Precision Dynamic Balancing
conveyorArchitectures.description: Industrial flight-type continuous conveyor warewasher used in high-volume institutional dining, university central facilities, and large hotels; equipped with high-pressure upper and lower wash manifolds, automated chemical injection pumps, and dual powered exhaust stacks.

conveyorArchitectures.name: Dual-Tank Continuous Rack Conveyor Warewasher (Champion / CMA / Stero C-Series, 250 Racks/Hr, 2.2 kW Pump, 300 CFM Canopy)
conveyorArchitectures.curtainMaterial: Standard Heavy-Duty PVC Slotted Curtains with Stainless Weights
conveyorArchitectures.description: Standard workhorse conveyor dishwasher in busy commercial restaurant kitchens, hospitals, and convention centers; features continuous pawl bar rack transport through recirculating wash and power-rinse zones.

conveyorArchitectures.name: Compact Single-Tank Rack Conveyor (Winterhalter / Jackson Energy Star, 120 Racks/Hr, 1.5 kW Pump, Ventless Condenser)
conveyorArchitectures.description: High-efficiency single-tank rack conveyor engineered for tight urban kitchens and commissary prep areas; relies on internal closed-loop heat recovery heat exchanger without direct outdoor ducting.

conveyorArchitectures.name: Heavy-Duty Utensil, Sheet Pan & Pot Washer (Douglas / Alvey Continuous Conveyor, Dual 5.5 kW Pumps, 550 GPM Wash Blast)
conveyorArchitectures.impellerMetallurgy: Duplex 2205 Stainless Steel Solid Cast Impeller
conveyorArchitectures.description: Industrial heavy-duty warewasher for institutional bakeries, commissary butcheries, and catering commissaries; operates at extreme hydraulic discharge pressures (up to 45 PSI) creating intense fluid shearing and high vapor nucleation potential.

conveyorArchitectures.name: Aged Door-Type Passthrough Commercial Dishwasher (12-Year-Old Unit, 60 Racks/Hr, 1.1 kW Pump, Defective Exhaust Hood)
conveyorArchitectures.curtainMaterial: None (Manual Lifting Hood Shell with Degraded Silicone Gasket)
conveyorArchitectures.impellerMetallurgy: Eroded Cast Bronze / 304 Composite Impeller with Leading-Edge Pitting
conveyorArchitectures.description: High-mileage passthrough warewasher common in small restaurants; manual deliming requires pouring concentrated liquid chemical descaler directly into open wash tank, causing immediate vapor billowing upon door lift.

descalerFormulations.name: Technical Phosphoric Acid Blend (H₃PO₄ 35% w/w + Low-Foam Fluorosurfactants, pH 1.1)
descalerFormulations.calciumCarbonateDissolutionRate: Moderate (Dissolves CaCO₃ to monocalcium phosphate without uncontrolled CO₂ explosion)
descalerFormulations.elastomerCompatibilityRating: Good with EPDM and FKM; Poor with NBR/Silicone
descalerFormulations.description: Industry standard commercial warewashing deliming formulation; high scale dissolution capacity with low volatility at normal deliming temperatures (50°C–60°C); creates manageable effervescence without rapid vapor bubble collapse.

descalerFormulations.name: Sulfamic Acid Rapid Descaler (H₃NSO₃ 20% w/w + Corrosion Inhibitors & Foaming Suppressants, pH 0.8)
descalerFormulations.calciumCarbonateDissolutionRate: Very High (Aggressive exothermic effervescence, releases intense CO₂ micro-bubbles)
descalerFormulations.elastomerCompatibilityRating: Superior with FKM; Moderate with EPDM; Catastrophic with NBR
descalerFormulations.description: Aggressive, fast-acting descaling agent used to rapidly strip deep calcified boilers and rinse nozzles; hydrolyzes into ammonium bisulfate when heated above 60°C, causing sudden release of pungent and stinging acidic aerosol micro-droplets.

descalerFormulations.name: Organic Glycolic & Citric Dual-Acid Descaler (Hydroxyacetic 18% + Citric 12% w/w, pH 1.7)
descalerFormulations.calciumCarbonateDissolutionRate: Moderate to High (Forms soluble calcium glycolate complexes with minimal foaming)
descalerFormulations.elastomerCompatibilityRating: Excellent with EPDM, FKM, and PTFE; Acceptable with Silicone
descalerFormulations.description: Eco-friendly, low-corrosion organic acid descaler formulated to protect thin-gauge 304 stainless steel heating elements and rinse tanks; higher ambient volatility yields distinct organic acid vapor odors in enclosed dishrooms.

descalerFormulations.name: Muriatic / Hydrochloric Acid 15% (HCl - BANNED & CONTRAINDICATED Under NSF/ANSI Standards)
descalerFormulations.calciumCarbonateDissolutionRate: Extreme / Violent (Instantaneous explosive effervescence and severe gas-binding)
descalerFormulations.elastomerCompatibilityRating: Destructive to all standard elastomers, destroys bronze fittings, induces stress corrosion cracking
descalerFormulations.description: Strictly prohibited chemical in commercial kitchen appliances; dissolves passive chromium oxide layer on stainless steel within seconds, causing catastrophic chloride stress corrosion cracking, weld seam pinholing, and toxic HCl gas release.

descalerFormulations.name: Food-Grade Anhydrous Citric Acid Solution (C₆H₈O₇ 25% w/w, pH 2.3)
descalerFormulations.calciumCarbonateDissolutionRate: Slow (Requires 65°C+ wash temperature; risk of calcium citrate precipitation if over-saturated)
descalerFormulations.elastomerCompatibilityRating: Compatible with all food-grade elastomers (EPDM, FKM, Silicone, NBR, PTFE)
descalerFormulations.description: Gentle organic descaler favored in bakeries and organic-certified food service; negligible respiratory toxicity and zero volatile fumes, but requires prolonged circulation cycles and risk of chalky calcium citrate precipitate in rinse jets.

elastomericSeals.name: FKM / Viton Fluoroelastomer (ASTM D1418 Type 1, Durometer 75A Shore)
elastomericSeals.phosphoricAcidResistance: A - Excellent (Less than 2% volume swelling after 1000 hrs at 65°C)
elastomericSeals.sulfamicAcidResistance: A - Excellent (Retains 94% tensile strength and elasticity)
elastomericSeals.cavitationErosionResistance: High (Superior tear resistance and elastic recovery against acoustic shockwaves)
elastomericSeals.failureMechanism: Gradual long-term hardening under extreme continuous temperatures (>180°C)
elastomericSeals.description: Premium industrial grade shaft and flange seal material; impervious to mineral and organic acids, preventing chemical leakage into pump motor bearings.

elastomericSeals.name: EPDM Rubber (Ethylene Propylene Diene Monomer, Peroxide-Cured 70A)
elastomericSeals.phosphoricAcidResistance: A- / B+ - Very Good (4–7% swelling in 35% acid at 60°C)
elastomericSeals.sulfamicAcidResistance: B - Good (Minor surface leaching of plasticizer over repeated 70°C cycles)
elastomericSeals.cavitationErosionResistance: Moderate (Resilient to moderate micro-implosions; degrades if water temperature exceeds 80°C)
elastomericSeals.failureMechanism: Compression set and swelling when exposed to grease/oil contaminants in wash water
elastomericSeals.description: Standard OEM seal supplied with modern commercial warewashers; highly reliable in aqueous acids and alkaline detergents, but susceptible to swelling if food fats or citrus solvent degreasers are present.

elastomericSeals.name: NBR / Buna-N Nitrile Rubber (Acrylonitrile Butadiene 65A Shore - Economy)
elastomericSeals.phosphoricAcidResistance: D - Severe Degradation (Rapid chemical embrittlement, hardening, micro-fissuring at pH < 2.5)
elastomericSeals.sulfamicAcidResistance: D - Critical Failure (Loss of elasticity in <50 descaling cycles; radial fracture under pressure)
elastomericSeals.cavitationErosionResistance: Poor (Brittle matrix chips and tears rapidly under cavitation bubble collapse)
elastomericSeals.failureMechanism: Severe acidic embrittlement, chemical hardening to >90 Shore A, followed by catastrophic shaft seal breach
elastomericSeals.description: Low-cost rubber frequently used in budget aftermarket replacement seals; highly vulnerable to acidic descalers, turning brittle and cracking within months of regular deliming.

elastomericSeals.name: PTFE / Teflon with Carbon-Graphite Rotary Face Mechanical Seal
elastomericSeals.phosphoricAcidResistance: A+ - Completely Inert (Zero chemical degradation in any commercial acid)
elastomericSeals.sulfamicAcidResistance: A+ - Completely Inert (Unaffected by boiling acid or bisulfate salts)
elastomericSeals.cavitationErosionResistance: Moderate-Low (Rigid brittle face susceptible to chipping and micro-cracking during acoustic cavitation)
elastomericSeals.failureMechanism: Brittle face fracture from violent dry-running or acoustic shockwaves during gas-binding
elastomericSeals.description: Heavy-duty mechanical seal assembly with stationary silicon carbide seat and rotating carbon-PTFE face; completely chemical resistant but vulnerable to vibration fracturing if the pump cavitates.

elastomericSeals.name: Silicone Rubber Food-Grade Gasket (Polydimethylsiloxane 60A Shore)
elastomericSeals.phosphoricAcidResistance: C - Moderate Degradation (Absorbs acid, swells 12–18%, loses 50% tensile strength)
elastomericSeals.sulfamicAcidResistance: C- - Rapid Degradation (Hydrolytic chain scission in hot acid, softens and extrudes from flange)
elastomericSeals.cavitationErosionResistance: Very Poor (Low tear strength; quickly shredded by turbulent fluid shearing)
elastomericSeals.failureMechanism: Acid-catalyzed hydrolysis of siloxane backbone, leading to gummy extrusion and flange blowout
elastomericSeals.description: Flexible manifold and curtain seal; ideal for dry heat and neutral water, but rapidly breaks down when subjected to concentrated acidic descaling solutions at elevated wash temperatures.

scaleMineralTypes.name: Heavy Crystalline Calcium Carbonate Scale (Calcite Encrustation > 3.0 mm, 24 GPG / 410 ppm Hardness)
scaleMineralTypes.effervescenceIntensity: Violent (Generates intense volume of CO₂ gas bubbles inside pump volute)
scaleMineralTypes.description: Thick rock-like mineral crust deposited in high-water-hardness municipal zones; generates violent effervescence upon contact with acid descaler, rapidly saturating wash water with CO₂ gas micro-bubbles that trigger severe pump cavitation.

scaleMineralTypes.name: Moderate Limescale & Magnesium Silicate Layer (1.5 mm Thickness, 14 GPG / 240 ppm Hardness)
scaleMineralTypes.effervescenceIntensity: Moderate Steady (Continuous bubbling over 20–35 minute cycle)
scaleMineralTypes.description: Typical semi-annual scale accumulation on heating coils, wash tank walls, and wash arms in commercial kitchens without softened reverse-osmosis feed water.

scaleMineralTypes.name: Light Surface Limescale Film & Mineral Hazing (< 0.5 mm Thickness, 6 GPG / 100 ppm Hardness)
scaleMineralTypes.chemicalComposition: 85% CaCO₃, 15% Soap Scum / Rinse Aid Precipitate
scaleMineralTypes.description: Thin mineral haze formed during routine monthly operations; quickly dissolved with mild organic or diluted phosphoric descalers without stress on mechanical components.

scaleMineralTypes.name: Composite Baked Protein-Lipid-Mineral Matrix (2.2 mm Encrusted Boiler & Wash Jet Scale)
scaleMineralTypes.chemicalComposition: 55% CaCO₃, 25% Denatured Proteins & Polymerized Lipids, 20% CaSO₄
scaleMineralTypes.effervescenceIntensity: Delayed / Foaming (Acid penetrates lipid barrier slowly, causing vigorous surfactant foaming)
scaleMineralTypes.description: Tenacious composite scale found in institutional pot-washing machines; lipid binder shields mineral calcite from acid attack, requiring chemical wetting agents and high wash temperatures to strip.

ventilationArchitectures.name: Dedicated Dual Powered Direct Exhaust Stacks (500 CFM / 235 L/s per Stack, -20 Pa Negative Draft)
ventilationArchitectures.description: Engineered direct-ducted stainless exhaust stacks mounted directly above machine entrance and exit tunnels; high capture velocity prevents chemical vapor escape into operator standing zones.

ventilationArchitectures.name: Shared Type II Kitchen Condensate Canopy Hood (250 CFM, Passive Draught Capture)
ventilationArchitectures.description: Generic kitchen ceiling canopy installed above warewasher; inadequate capture velocity allows acid aerosols to spill past end curtains during rack entry and exit.

ventilationArchitectures.name: Ventless Energy Recovery Heat Exchanger (Closed-Loop Condensing Coils, No Outdoor Stack)
ventilationArchitectures.description: Internal condensing coils capture moisture vapor but do not neutralize or filter volatile acidic chemical gases (such as glycolic acid or sulfamic aerosols), which bleed into dishroom ambient air.

ventilationArchitectures.name: Zero Direct Ventilation / Defective Exhaust Blower (0 CFM Direct, Passive Room Air Exchange Only)
ventilationArchitectures.description: Severely compromised kitchen environment where exhaust fan has failed or dampers are shut; 100% of generated chemical acid vapors billow directly into dishroom workers' breathing zone.
